subject: Next steps + rotating demo slots (US/EU/APAC)
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Yang <sophie.yang@acmehealth.com>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@medsys.co.uk>, Kenji Nakamura <kenji@kumi.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps + rotating demo slots (US/EU/APAC)

Hi Sophie / Raj / Kenji —

Thanks again for your time today — really helpful to understand Acme Health's priorities around latency (p95 under 400ms for summary generation) and the need for private deployment for PHI-handling endpoints. A couple quick next steps I promised:

1) Schedule a technical deep-dive/demo with our infra lead (Aditya) to go over model selection, KV cache behavior, and network requirements.
2) Share a proposed mutual action plan and a short slide deck on architecture.

To make scheduling simpler across US/EU/APAC, can we try a rotating set of weekly demo slots so the burden to wake up at odd hours is shared? Proposed recurring slots (pick two that work for the team):

- Option A (rotating week 1): 08:00 PT / 11:00 ET / 16:00 GMT (works for US morning + EU afternoon)
- Option B (rotating week 2): 14:00 PT / 17:00 ET / 22:00 GMT (better for APAC night shift)
- Option C (rotating week 3): 00:00 PT / 03:00 ET / 08:00 GMT (early EU, late US)

If you prefer, we can also do a single slot that alternates every week between a US-friendly time and an EU-friendly time. I dropped a provisional calendar event here: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=rotate-demo-acme-20270325

Attached: redwood-demo-slides.pdf (short product + infra overview) and a draft mutual-action-plan.xlsx.

If those options look good, tell us which two slots you'd like and Aditya and I will lock a recurring invite and share an agenda for a 60-minute technical deep-dive.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
camila@redwood.com

From: Sophie Yang <sophie.yang@acmehealth.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>

Thanks Camila — great session today.

We like the rotating idea. For Acme Health the majority of the stakeholders are in US and EU; Kenji will join from APAC when possible. My immediate availability:

- Tue 23 Mar: 11:00 GMT (works)
- Thu 25 Mar: 16:00 GMT (works)

Prefer Option A for the first two weeks and then rotate to something later in the day for APAC. Can Aditya cover the KV caching and quantization recommendations in the demo? I want to confirm our SRE and data-security folks are available for the second hour if needed.

Sophie

Camila / Sophie —

Thanks for proposing options. I can do the Thu 25 Mar 16:00 GMT slot Sophie suggested. Also happy with a rotation where EU gets a couple of friendly slots (15:00-17:00 GMT) every other week — our team can cover the early/late US slots as needed.

On the security side, we'd like a short (15 min) call with your compliance engineer during the technical deep-dive to run through data residency and audit log retention settings.

— Raj

1) 10 min — recap of goals / expected SLOs (Camila + Sophie)
2) 20 min — infra & runtime deep-dive (me): kernel selection, KV cache behavior, batching/latency tradeoffs
3) 15 min — security/compliance checklist (compliance engineer joins)
4) 15 min — next steps / mutual action plan review

I attached a short draft agenda note (deep-dive-agenda.md) in case you want to tweak. Also happy to move the repeating rotation to Option A (US morning / EU afternoon) for the first month then alternate to an APAC-friendly week.

Perfect — thanks everyone for the quick replies.

I'll lock Thu 25 Mar 16:00 GMT for the first technical deep-dive (60 minutes) and create a recurring invite that alternates week-to-week between Option A (US morning / EU afternoon) and Option B (APAC-friendly evening). Invite and the finalized mutual-action-plan.xlsx are attached.

Action items:
- Camila: send recurring calendar invite + finalized MAP (attached).
- Aditya: bring infra + quantization recommendations and loop compliance engineer for the 15 min security block.
- Sophie/Raj/Kenji: confirm attendee list and whether SRE/compliance need more than 15 min.

If we need to shift the rotation cadence after the first two sessions, we'll adjust. Looking forward to it.

Cheers,
